Name: Normalized x-coordinate
Description: Horizontal coordinate of the node normalised against the centre of mass of the foreground mask; locates the critical point of the skeleton along the horizontal axis of the image plane.

Name: Normalized y-coordinate
Description: Vertical coordinate of the node normalised against the centre of mass; locates the critical point along the vertical axis.

Name: Distance to centroid
Description: Normalised radial distance of the node from the centre of mass; distinguishes central skeletal points from peripheral ones.

Name: Angle with OX
Description: Orientation angle of the segment in degrees for Vector nodes; angle of convergence of incident segments for Point nodes; an invariant shape descriptor of the segment.

Name: Endpoint flag
Description: Boolean feature; affirmative when the node has degree one and therefore terminates a single segment of the skeleton.

Name: Corner flag
Description: Boolean feature; affirmative when the node registers a direction change exceeding a fixed angular threshold.

Name: Junction angle (min)
Description: The smallest internal angle at a bifurcation point between converging segments; distinguishes acute from open junctions of the skeleton.

Name: Neighbour endpoint count
Description: Number of adjacent Point nodes flagged as endpoints; characterises the local density of dead-end branches near the node.

Name: Neighbour junction count
Description: Number of adjacent Point nodes flagged as junctions; characterises proximity to complex structural articulations.

Name: Average neighbour vector length
Description: Mean normalised length of segments incident to a Point node; characterises the local geometric scale around the point.

Name: Horizontal direction
Description: Categorical feature defined for Vector nodes; orientation of the segment along the OX axis (left or right).

Name: Vertical direction
Description: Categorical feature defined for Vector nodes; orientation of the segment along the OY axis (up or down).

Name: Length ratio to maximum
Description: Ratio of a Vector node's length to the longest segment in the graph; distinguishes principal strokes from short connecting segments.

Name: Graph eccentricity
Description: Maximum hop-distance (in edges) from the node to any other node of the graph; endpoints have high eccentricity, central nodes low.
